title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Lyric Performing Arts Center, Baltimore | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Lyric Performing Arts Center in Baltimore, Maryland, USA, on 7 September 2022.

It was the 13th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022, and the second of two consecutive nights in Baltimore.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘What Goes On’
  • ‘Free Ride’ (Edgar Winter)
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)

  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’

  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
